summary: Story 132.8 closes Epic 132 as readiness-contract-complete_not_live_activation only. It records source evidence for Stories 132.1-132.7, gate wiring plus executed subordinate Story 132.1-132.7 checkers and self-tests, readiness-domain coverage, fail-closed unsupported surfaces, and non-leader code-review/UltraQA quality gates without live activation, provisioning, production migration, host mutation, credentials, load/restore/scaling execution, DB mTLS production activation, or runtime audit emitters.

epic_closure.required_statement: Epic 132 is readiness-contract-complete_not_live_activation; split deployment, remote Postgres, scaling, load/restore execution, production DB mTLS activation, provisioning, production credentials, production migrations, production host mutation, and runtime audit emitters remain deferred/fail-closed until later approved activation stories.

topology.evidence: Story 132.1 topology contract preserves service placement, network boundaries, data authority, unsupported topologies, rollback/fallback, and DB mTLS deferment.

remote_postgres.evidence: Story 132.2 remote Postgres contract preserves SQLite defaults and requires bounded pool, migration, backup/restore, redaction, and mTLS composition evidence.

registry_profile.evidence: Story 132.3 registry remote Postgres profile overlay remains opt-in and requires shared REGISTRY_DATABASE_URL, migration evidence, and DB mTLS composition.

worker_mcp_event_bus_profile.evidence: Story 132.4 worker/MCP/event-bus split profile remains opt-in, internal-only, token-placeholder gated, and preserves stdio/local defaults.

operator_dashboard_profile.evidence: Story 132.5 operator/dashboard split profile remains opt-in with Telegram/clawhip compose scope, host-side console-cli, and future dashboard ingress readiness.

horizontal_scaling.evidence: Story 132.6 horizontal scaling readiness records scale classes, singleton authorities, coordination boundaries, load-balancer readiness, rollback, and observability.

failure_load_backup_restore_validation.evidence: Story 132.7 failure/load/backup/restore validation readiness records required scenarios, bounded synthetic-load evidence, isolated restore, checksum/manifest, observability, and safety boundaries.

db_mtls_epic_133_composition.evidence: Epic 132 composes with Epic 133 DB mTLS readiness through deferred REGISTRY_DB_MTLS_* evidence and explicitly does not activate DB mTLS in production.

required_fail_closed_statements: future activation requires a later approved activation story

local_checker.evidence: Focused local closure checker, pytest, ruff check, ruff format, and executed subordinate Story 132.1-132.7 checker/self-test gates are required before final closure.

ci_wiring.evidence: justfile check-gates/check-gates-self-test and .github/workflows/ci.yml include Story 132.1-132.8 checker and self-test commands.

code_review.evidence: Non-leader code-reviewer source must approve the Story 132.8 closure checker, docs, status, and wiring as readiness-only closure evidence; source_reference must be backed by native subagent provenance: local OMX subagent tracking plus agent-turn-complete logs when present, or the committed sanitized native-subagent provenance bundle when local runtime state is absent.
